experiences.intent: Traverse a channel message list and open a thread without leaving the keyboard
experiences.entryCommand: open http://127.0.0.1:8787/ and enter Community Web
experiences.observableSuccess: Tab enters one selected message; ArrowUp/ArrowDown or j/k moves it; Enter opens the selected thread with visible and announced focus
experiences.observableFailure: Messages are skipped by Tab, focus is invisible, or navigation requires mutating internal app state
confusionRisks: a visual feed that is not an operable message list
arrow keys scrolling the page instead of moving the selected message

experiences.intent: Define one reusable action and invoke it from the terminal-style prompt
experiences.entryCommand: open http://127.0.0.1:8787/ and run macro set review = cd /projects/epoch/changes; view state:needs-review
experiences.observableSuccess: The action persists, appears in help, and runs the same existing commands without arbitrary script execution
experiences.observableFailure: Separate macro UI duplicates commands, definitions disappear, or custom actions execute arbitrary JavaScript
confusionRisks: shell aliases that can execute unrestricted code
a settings form disconnected from the terminal prompt

experiences.intent: Expose a user-defined action to agents and voice without redefining the workflow
experiences.entryCommand: open http://127.0.0.1:8787/ and define a named macro with a voice phrase
experiences.observableSuccess: The macro is registered as an agent tool and the same action runs from an exact voice phrase
experiences.observableFailure: Agent, voice, and prompt controls drift into separate definitions or voice guesses at near matches
confusionRisks: custom prompt text presented as a verified tool
fuzzy voice matching that runs the wrong action
